- docs/plans/claude-actions-worker-pool-plan.md:126-225 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The plan introduces the `ai:claude-pool-waiting` label for consumer-repo PRs and sweep searches without registering it in `.github/ai/label_contract.v1.json`.
  WHY: Consumer repos may not have the label, causing `gh pr edit --add-label` to return 422 and preventing the sweep from finding and resuming waiting projects.
- docs/plans/claude-actions-worker-pool-plan.md:203 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The dispatcher reads only one `per_page=100` page of worker runs to find the newest run for each open queue item.
  WHY: Under the planned workload, an item's run can fall beyond page 1 and be treated as missing, causing a duplicate concurrent dispatch for that item.
- docs/plans/claude-actions-worker-pool-plan.md:185-205 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The plan does not specify how the report job produces a result when account selection returns `all_gated` or `no_accounts` and the work job has no transcript.
  WHY: Without a synthesized result, the dispatcher may treat the artifact as missing and redispatch before `resetsAt`.
